evidence.sql: WITH ledger AS (SELECT material_id,product_id,sum(CASE WHEN movement_type IN ('IN','ADJUST_IN') THEN quantity ELSE -quantity END) qty FROM stock_movements GROUP BY material_id,product_id) SELECT count(*) FROM inventories i FULL JOIN ledger l ON COALESCE(i.material_id,0)=COALESCE(l.material_id,0) AND COALESCE(i.product_id,0)=COALESCE(l.product_id,0) WHERE COALESCE(i.quantity,0)<>COALESCE(l.qty,0) OR i.quantity<0

SELECT count(*) FROM purchase_receipts p WHERE (p.status='COMPLETED' AND (EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM purchase_receipt_items d WHERE d.purchase_receipt_id=p.id AND (SELECT count(*) FROM stock_movements s WHERE s.purchase_receipt_id=p.id AND s.material_id=d.material_id AND s.movement_type='IN' AND s.quantity=d.quantity)<>1) OR (SELECT count(*) FROM stock_movements s WHERE s.purchase_receipt_id=p.id)<>(SELECT count(*) FROM purchase_receipt_items d WHERE d.purchase_receipt_id=p.id))) OR (p.status<>'COMPLETED' AND EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM stock_movements s WHERE s.purchase_receipt_id=p.id))

SELECT count(*) FROM material_issue_requests p WHERE (p.status='APPROVED' AND (EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM material_issue_request_items d WHERE d.request_id=p.id AND (SELECT count(*) FROM stock_movements s WHERE s.material_issue_request_id=p.id AND s.material_id=d.material_id AND s.movement_type='OUT' AND s.quantity=d.quantity)<>1) OR (SELECT count(*) FROM stock_movements s WHERE s.material_issue_request_id=p.id)<>(SELECT count(*) FROM material_issue_request_items d WHERE d.request_id=p.id))) OR (p.status<>'APPROVED' AND EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM stock_movements s WHERE s.material_issue_request_id=p.id))

SELECT count(*) FROM finished_goods_issue_requests p WHERE (p.status='APPROVED' AND (EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM finished_goods_issue_request_items d WHERE d.request_id=p.id AND (SELECT count(*) FROM stock_movements s WHERE s.fg_issue_request_id=p.id AND s.product_id=d.product_id AND s.movement_type='OUT' AND s.quantity=d.quantity)<>1) OR (SELECT count(*) FROM stock_movements s WHERE s.fg_issue_request_id=p.id)<>(SELECT count(*) FROM finished_goods_issue_request_items d WHERE d.request_id=p.id))) OR (p.status<>'APPROVED' AND EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM stock_movements s WHERE s.fg_issue_request_id=p.id))

SELECT count(*) FROM productions p JOIN production_requests pr ON pr.id=p.production_request_id WHERE (p.status='COMPLETED' AND ((SELECT count(*) FROM stock_movements s WHERE s.production_id=p.id AND s.product_id=pr.product_id AND s.movement_type='IN' AND s.quantity=p.quantity)<>1 OR (SELECT count(*) FROM stock_movements s WHERE s.production_id=p.id)<>1)) OR (p.status<>'COMPLETED' AND EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM stock_movements s WHERE s.production_id=p.id))

SELECT count(*) FROM production_requests r WHERE COALESCE((SELECT sum(p.quantity) FROM productions p WHERE p.production_request_id=r.id AND p.status<>'CANCELLED'),0)>r.quantity OR ((r.status='COMPLETED')<>(COALESCE((SELECT sum(p.quantity) FROM productions p WHERE p.production_request_id=r.id AND p.status='COMPLETED'),0)=r.quantity))

SELECT count(*) FROM (SELECT p.id,d.material_id,sum(d.quantity) qty,max(bi.quantity*p.quantity) lim FROM material_issue_request_items d JOIN material_issue_requests r ON r.id=d.request_id JOIN production_requests p ON p.id=r.production_request_id LEFT JOIN bom_items bi ON bi.bom_id=p.bom_id AND bi.material_id=d.material_id WHERE r.status IN ('PENDING','APPROVED') GROUP BY p.id,d.material_id HAVING max(bi.quantity*p.quantity) IS NULL OR sum(d.quantity)>max(bi.quantity*p.quantity)) bad
SELECT count(*) FROM (SELECT product_id FROM boms WHERE is_active GROUP BY product_id HAVING count(*)>1) bad
SELECT count(*) FROM production_requests p JOIN boms b ON b.id=p.bom_id WHERE b.product_id<>p.product_id
SELECT count(*) FROM purchase_receipts p WHERE p.total_amount<>COALESCE((SELECT sum(d.amount) FROM purchase_receipt_items d WHERE d.purchase_receipt_id=p.id),0)

SELECT count(*) FROM (SELECT status,reviewed_by,reviewed_at FROM material_issue_requests UNION ALL SELECT status,reviewed_by,reviewed_at FROM finished_goods_issue_requests) r WHERE (status IN ('APPROVED','REJECTED') AND (reviewed_by IS NULL OR reviewed_at IS NULL)) OR (status IN ('PENDING','CANCELLED') AND (reviewed_by IS NOT NULL OR reviewed_at IS NOT NULL))
